tool.name: Derive amplicon panel
tool.description: reconstruct an amplicon panel FASTA from genome-mapped reads (coverage peaks = amplicons), PyEuk derive-panel
tool.command: @REF_RESOLVE@ ## Amplicon locations are a property of the assay, shared by every specimen, so this is a ## COHORT-level reduction over a SAMPLE of genome-mapped BAMs -- not a per-specimen step. mkdir -p bams && #for $i, $b in enumerate($bams) ln -s '$b' 'bams/${i}.bam' && ln -s '${b.metadata.bam_index}' 'bams/${i}.bam.bai' && #end for ln -s '$ref_path' genome.fa && pyeuk derive-panel --bams bams/*.bam --genome genome.fa --sample $advanced.sample --min-depth-frac $advanced.min_depth_frac --min-abs-depth $advanced.min_abs_depth --min-length $advanced.min_length --merge-gap $advanced.merge_gap --pad $advanced.pad --prefix '$advanced.prefix' --out '$panel' --out-bed '$bed' --out-qc '$qc'

param.name: bams
param.label: Genome-mapped BAMs (a sample of the cohort)
param.help: Reads mapped to the reference genome, not a panel. A representative subset is enough; use the Advanced 'How many BAMs to scan' to cap it.

expand.label: Reference genome the BAMs were mapped to
expand.help: Used to extract each peak sequence into the panel: a FASTA from your history, or a genome cached on this Galaxy.

param.label: How many BAMs to scan
param.help: How many BAMs to scan, evenly strided across the input. 0 = all.

param.label: Minimum peak depth (fraction of max)
param.help: A peak must reach this fraction of the run's maximum depth. Data-adaptive, so it needs no retuning across datasets.

param.label: Absolute depth floor
param.help: Absolute depth floor a peak must clear.

param.label: Merge peaks closer than (bp)
param.help: Join peaks closer than this, to bridge a dip in the middle of an amplicon (bases).

param.label: Pad each peak by (bp)
param.help: Extend each peak by this many bases at both ends.

param.label: Amplicon name prefix
param.help: Name prefix for the derived amplicons.

tool.help:
Reconstructs an amplicon panel de novo from read coverage, for a cohort whose primer scheme and target coordinates are unknown. Targeted amplicon sequencing concentrates reads into sharp depth peaks against an unamplified genomic background, so mapping a sample of reads to a draft reference genome delineates the amplified targets.
The tool discovers contiguous coverage peaks with a data-adaptive threshold -- a peak must reach ``min_depth_frac`` of the run's own maximum depth, which needs no retuning across datasets -- and exports each peak's reference sequence to a panel FASTA. It isolates regions of high, uniform coverage and excludes dropout-prone loci; inferred panels frequently give higher and more uniform cohort coverage than the original curated markers.
Input: genome-mapped BAMs (a sample), and the reference genome. Output: the derived panel FASTA (a drop-in for the panel input of the Standard workflow), a BED of the peaks, and a per-peak QC table. @HELP_FOOTER@
